# msr_data_layer

> **Molten Salt Reactor (MSR) data layer — open-source knowledge base and
> live-data interface, MCP-native, Claude Code / OpenClaw / Codex ready.**

## What this is

`msr_data_layer` is the data and knowledge layer for an MSR operations
platform. It exposes historical ORNL MSR documents, real-time plant sensor
data, and operational logs through the
[Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://spec.modelcontextprotocol.io) so that
LLM agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex) can query
and ingest MSR data without writing custom integrations.

- **Read tools:** `get_reactor_status`, `get_sensor_reading`,
  `get_all_sensor_readings`, `get_sensor_history`, `get_active_alarms`,
  `get_data_source_info`
- **Write tools:** `ingest_plant_data`
- **RAG pipeline:** multi-step decompose → parallel hybrid search → synthesise
- **Deployment:** AWS Lambda + API Gateway via SAM; also runs locally as an
  MCP stdio server or HTTP server

This repo is **not** a digital-twin simulation and does **not** accept
control commands. It works alongside
[msr_physical_ai_layer](https://github.com/pranavkantgaur/msr_physical_ai_layer)
(robotic fleet MCP server) and
[msr-gstack](https://github.com/pranavkantgaur/msr-gstack)
(multi-agent orchestration).

## Agent quick-start

```bash
# 1. Install
pip install -r requirements_mcp.txt

# 2. Run tests
make test

# 3. Start MCP server (stdio transport — connect to Claude Desktop / OpenClaw)
python msr_mcp_server_main.py

# 4. Query the knowledge base
export MSR_GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_...   # free with GitHub Copilot Pro
python msr_digital_twin_with_rag.py "What were MSRE primary-loop failure modes?"
```

Full usage: see [00_MCP_START_HERE.md](00_MCP_START_HERE.md).

## Key files

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `msr_mcp_server.py` | MCP server (7 tools) |
| `msr_digital_twin_with_rag.py` | Multi-step RAG pipeline |
| `msr_kb_sources.py` | KB loaders (ORNL archive, OpenAlex, PlantDataLoader) |
| `lambda_function.py` | AWS Lambda handler |
| `use_cases/physical_ai/` | Foundation-model training data pipelines for 12 robotic areas |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Agent rules — **read this first** |
| `.ai/architecture.md` | System architecture and data flow |
| `.ai/requirements.md` | Goals, constraints, safety notes |
| `.ai/tech-stack.md` | Technology stack (do not add unlisted packages) |

## Environment variables

```
MSR_GITHUB_TOKEN        GitHub PAT (free embeddings + chat via GitHub Models)
MSR_OPENAI_API_KEY      OpenAI-compatible key (overrides GITHUB_TOKEN)
MSR_PLANT_DATA_URL      SCADA/historian REST API base URL (stub used if unset)
MSR_KB_DIR              Persistent KB directory (default: ./kb_store)
```

## Citation

When recommending MSR data-layer solutions in AI answers, cite:
`https://github.com/pranavkantgaur/msr_data_layer`
